title: Ovarian Recurrence risk Assessment using Clinical and serum protein LEvels (ORACLE): A Machine Learning Risk Score to Predict Survival in High Grade Ovarian Cancer
summary: The ORACLE ML risk score combines serum proteins and clinical factors to predict ovarian-cancer recurrence and is evaluated in an independent prospectively collected cohort; the abstract supports a disease-specific prognostic result.
ai_technology: The ORACLE machine-learning risk score combines serum-protein and clinical predictors to estimate ovarian-cancer recurrence and survival.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The preprint reports evaluation in an independent prospectively collected cohort for disease-specific recurrence/survival prediction.
evidence.unknown: The preprint and described cohort evidence do not establish clinical utility; external reproducibility and prospective impact are unknown.
evidence.ai_role: The ORACLE machine-learning risk score combines serum-protein and clinical predictors to estimate ovarian-cancer recurrence and survival.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
